💡 عوامل مهمة لا تظهر في الرقم لكنها تؤثر: 💡 Important factors that don't show in the number but affect your decision
القسط الشهري رقم مهم، لكن القرار الصحيح: The monthly installment is an important number, but the right decision also takes other things into account:
كم ستبقى في المدينة أو المنطقة نفسها؟: How long will you stay in the same city or area?
— إذا كان وضعك الوظيفي أو العائلي قد يتغ: — If your job or family situation may change in the next 3 to 5 years, renting gives you more flexibility to move without the complications of selling property. The longer your plan to stay in the same place, the more buying is usually favored.
رسوم الشراء الإضافية لا الدفعة الأولى فق: Additional purchase fees, not just the down payment
— رسوم تسجيل العقار، وأتعاب الدلّال، وأح: — Property registration fees, the broker's commission, and sometimes legal due-diligence fees are all one-time costs paid on top of the house price, and many people forget them when planning the purchase budget.
الصيانة تصبح مسؤوليتك بالكامل بعد الشراء: Maintenance becomes entirely your responsibility after buying
— فبصفتك مالكاً، أي عطل في السباكة أو ال: — As an owner, any plumbing, electrical or roof problem is at your expense, unlike a tenant who can usually go back to the landlord in these cases (depending on the lease). Set aside part of your monthly budget as a maintenance reserve if you decide to buy.
قيمة العقار قد ترتفع وقد لا ترتفع: Property value may or may not rise
— الشراء يبني ملكية، لكن قيمة العقار مست: — Buying builds ownership, but the future value of the property is not guaranteed and depends on the market and location. Don't automatically treat buying as a “guaranteed investment”, especially if you plan to stay in the home for a short time.
راتبك ومصادر دخلك المستقبلية: Your salary and future income sources
— قسط شهري ثابت لعشرين سنة التزام طويل ا: — A fixed monthly installment for twenty years is a long-term commitment, so make sure your income stability matches this commitment before you sign, especially if your income comes from a single source.
📌 هذه عوامل عامة للتفكير فيها، وليست نصي: 📌 These are general factors to consider, not financial or real-estate advice tailored to your situation; for any major decision, consult a financial advisor or a real-estate lawyer.
ما الأمور التي لا تحسبها هذه الحاسبة؟: What does this calculator not account for?
رسوم التسجيل والدلالية، الصيانة كمالك، ا: Registration and brokerage fees, maintenance as an owner, possible future rise in property value, and the flexibility of moving as a tenant — all real factors, but hard to turn into a single number. Treat the comparison as a starting point.
ما الفرق الأساسي بين الإيجار والشراء من: What is the main financial difference between renting and buying?
في الإيجار يكون مصروفك ثابتاً ومعروفاً،: When renting, your expense is fixed and known, but nothing comes back to you after the years pass. When buying, you pay an installment (often higher than the rent at first because of interest) but you build ownership of the property over time. A proper comparison must take into account how long you expect to stay in the city or the home itself; the longer the stay, the more buying is usually favored.
